ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  BEML Limited has announced the cessation of Shri Sanjay Som, Director (Mining & Construction Business), effective September 30, 2026, due to superannuation. The material impact involves an interim leadership structure, with Shri Rajeev Kumar Gupta (Director, Rail & Metro Business) taking on additional charge of the Mining & Construction segment, ensuring continuity but potentially leading to increased workload or a temporary lack of dedicated focus for that division until a permanent replacement is appointed. No red flags are apparent, as the departure is a routine personnel change due to retirement.
